'''Tabi''' is a ''[[damane]]'' in the [[Seanchan]] army. Her ''[[sul'dam]]'' is [[Surya]].

== Appearance ==
She has pale eyes.

== Activities ==
She is present at the meeting between the [[Dragon Reborn]] and the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]], when it was revealed that the latter was actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise.
